characters.look: Ana, an 11-year-old girl of a semi-nomadic herding family of the steppe, alert, curious, serious face, a long dark braid, a knee-length plain wool tunic with a fringed wool shawl over one shoulder, a cord belt, bare feet

head and shoulders, three-quarter, amazed and curious: eyes wide, lips parted in wonder, no teeth
